purpose: Extend country investigation into the normalized global graph without turning nonspatial entities into fake geographic features.

scope.map_drawing: Only canonical country endpoints may navigate back to Earth geography in this first implementation. Other endpoints remain nonspatial inspector/archive objects.

time.rule: Only valid_from/valid_to are treated as validity intervals. A generic relationship date is provenance/record context and is not silently promoted to valid_from.
time.unknown: Historical views label relationships with unknown validity rather than assuming timelessness.

evidence.rule: Entity Trace exposes existing classifications; it does not combine them into a single truth score.

routing.rule: Archive navigation must resolve through data/global-graph-bridge.json or a canonical node/country ID handled by the bridge's declared public reader.
routing.forbidden: Do not invent standalone entity routes.

epistemic_boundary: Graph adjacency does not imply causation, moral responsibility, political allegiance or geographic proximity.
Nonspatial concepts are not assigned latitude/longitude merely because they connect to a country.
Project, comparative, framework and observed relations retain their evidence classes.
One-hop display is an investigation surface, not a claim of completeness.

before_multi_hop: honor Time validity in traversal rather than display only
deduplicate equivalent endpoints through bridge/registry rules
define spatial-anchor provenance for any non-country map rendering
growth_gate.next: After those gates, entity BFS may expand to 2–3 hops in a nonspatial graph plane or selectively back onto Earth for honestly geocoded endpoints.
